reason: We do library storytime, parks and church groups, and I almost never pay for kid stuff. I'd take the free first visit, but $14 a kid when I'll just be chasing my kid around instead of drinking the coffee is hard to justify.
objection: I'll still be chasing my kid, so I won't really get to sit and drink coffee, and the free options already work for us.
would_change_my_mind: A flat drop-in around $5 to $6 for the first kid, or a free-with-purchase deal on shift days when the parks are too hot or rainy.
